column1: # Rows of an existing crate that wait for a later subtask (parity/src/ledger.rs, Unported):
# crate, file prefix, subtask. Remove an entry when its subtask ports those files.
# roamgate-http was made by S13 for the settings family; the rest of its rows
# wait for the front (S18). settings-rpc.test.ts holds the worktree, profile
# and connection-namespace handlers that stay in Bun with their families
# (S16, S17) and the reply plumbing of the front (S18): the latest is named.
# roamgate-workspace was made by S17 with the HTML preview and the worktree
# command templates; the rest of the workspace and worktree files are S17's
# roamgate-voice-server holds voice.json, profiles, speakers, Kokoro's
# languages, the helper supervisor, hardware, models, downloads, setup,
# low-GPU, stock voices and the library (S22, landed Bun-owned); these wait.
# The HTTP routes, call handoff's redeem route, Surprise, the CLI, the voice
# socket, its signalling relay and the companion layer but its tools are
# ported; the tools and voice.test.ts's companion cases wait.
# roamgate-claude was made by S15 for the tool registry; the Claude driver,
# the claude-mod hub and the conversation drivers come with their subtasks.
